positive_snippets: In my opinion awesome destination for weekends and bussiness trips....I always wants to stay whenever I will visit delhi ...overall all admin nd staff behaviour superbe ..

Apart from location, everything else is fine.
Rooms are clean
Staff is good.
Exactly behind Bikanervala.

We arrived in Delhi from the airport and the hotel booked us our driver which was really helpful from them.

The room was clean and the AC + fan were working very well.

The staff was very nice also and helpful.

The location was very good near the metro.
Delhi metro is very well organized and I suggest everybody to take the metro instead of some tuktuk who can be very expensive for tourists.
